notes.title: Beta v1.1
notes.content:
Update Beta v1.1

Added

- A New Achievement:


 "Bouncing off the walls"

Fixed

- All objects in editor rotating when rotating one clock-wise

- The playing levels page exiting into the Workshop Hub

- Completing levels giving you multiple points towards achievements instead of one

notes.title: Cuub Playtest Requests now open!
notes.content:
Hi all!

As the development of Cuub continues, there will be more and more content that I will add to the game (that's kind of how game development works I guess) - and since I am a one person team it will become increasingly hard to find bugs, problems and improvements to look for.

That's where YOU come in! 

When I think that Cuub is in a state where it's (semi)-stable, fun, engaging and presentable I will allow you all to test out the game for a short period of time! for free! This is so that you can provide feedback about things you would like my to add or could be done better, and report bugs that I can fix!
(I promise it's not being a lab rat, it's just testing :)!

So, how can you join this playtest where you can try the game? - I'm glad you asked!

If you head over to the steam page for Cuub, there will be a button underneath the "wishlist" button (you should totally wishlist the game by the way! :D) - this mysterious button will let you request to join the playtest! Which means that when the first playtest is ready to play, you can install it!

(Here's what the button looks like!)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763704/4fc2111dcc80791a26d8231e0ed161138f16f6dd.png

Don't worry, you will be notified when the playtest becomes available.

Thanks everyone!

- ShxDowXD (Developer)

notes.title: The Cuub Steam page is now live!
notes.content:
Thanks to all your support, the Cuub Steam page is now public!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763704/bd09a5775a43e99b7e54997c6e8e406e86e8408a.png

I've been working on this game for years, evolving it over time and now it is finally visible to the big wide world!

I would like to take a moment to thank you all for supporting me on this journey, and I will continue working on Cuub until it is ready for release - and keep providing lots of updates!
I'll keep you all updated on the state of the game up until launch, so stay tuned!

Thank you all so much,

ShxDowXD
